title: 做空英伟达：账面赚240亿，财报前波动升温，还敢押吗？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Joining us now is that Shi Cha, financial advisor and managing director at UBS.
segments.zh: 现在加入我们的是瑞银财务顾问兼董事总经理Shi Cha。

segments.en: Shi, thank you so much for joining us today and a lot to get through, but I do want to start on those tech themes that we're looking at.
segments.zh: Shi，非常感谢你今天加入我们，有很多要讨论的，但我想先从我们关注的那些科技主题开始。

segments.en: Short sellers have made a bundle going short in video, $24 billion on that slide.
segments.zh: 做空者通过做空英伟达赚了一大笔，在那次下跌中赚了240亿美元。

segments.en: How do you position in this stock ahead of this week's earnings, especially against this backdrop of not only Gents and Huangs personal difficulties, but the tougher export
segments.zh: 在本周财报发布前，你如何定位这只权益资产，尤其是在黄仁勋个人困难以及美国释放的更严格出口限制信号的背景下？

segments.en: restrictions that the U.S. is signaling as well, this is going to be a really tough earnings call.
segments.zh: 这将是一次非常艰难的财报电话会议。

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, this is just about the worst backdrop you can have for this upcoming earnings call, but we certainly expect further near term volatility on the stock and overall
segments.zh: 是的，对于即将到来的财报电话会议来说，这几乎是最糟糕的背景，但我们确实预计该股和整体AI交易短期内会进一步波动。

segments.en: AI trade. You know, I think Gents and really had a huge personal, not the driver of AI, the whole AI ecosystem
segments.zh: 你知道，我认为黄仁勋确实有巨大的个人影响，不是AI的驱动者，而是整个AI生态系统。

segments.en: and with his departure, whether he's coming back or not, I think the markets are really preparing for a slowdown or reduced in capital into the AI ecosystem and probably further
segments.zh: 随着他的离开，无论他是否回来，我认为市场真的在准备迎接AI生态系统的放缓或资本减少，并且可能进一步扰乱供应链。

segments.en: disruptions to the supply chain. So I mean, I think we're definitely expecting more volatility in the stock and the AI trade
segments.zh: 所以，我的意思是，我们肯定预计该股和AI交易总体上会有更多波动。

segments.en: in general, and we have been keeping our investors informed and also urging investors to just stay invested and diversified across sectors, regions and asset classes.
segments.zh: 我们一直让市场参与者了解情况，并敦促市场参与者保持**，跨行业、地区和资产类别进行多元化配置。
